name: MATHQA
intro: MathQA 是一个将 AQuA-RAT 中 37,259 道英文多项选择数学文字题与可执行运算程序对齐的数据集。论文定义了包含 58 种领域感知运算的表示语言，通过动态众包平台和多人验证获得可解释的逐步求解程序。
org: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI
build_method: 众包标注, 人工验证
task_type: 数学文字题, 程序生成
eval_feature: 可解释推理, 可执行程序
intro_en: MathQA aligns 37,259 English multiple-choice math word problems from AQuA-RAT with executable operation programs. The paper defines a representation language of 58 domain-aware operations and obtains interpretable step-by-step solutions through a dynamic crowdsourcing platform and multi-person validation.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Select solvable numeric AQuA-RAT questions and preserve five options"] --> B["Define 58 operations and categorize problems to prune the operation space"]
    B --> C["Crowd-author executable operation programs on a dynamic platform"]
    C --> D["Require use of a problem value and a final value close to the correct option"]
    D --> E["Control worker quality and accept alignment with at least two of three votes"]
    E --> F["Expand annotations to near-duplicate templates and assemble 37,259 items"]
    F --> G["Randomly split 80/12/8 into train, development, and test sets"]
    G --> H["Decode and execute programs, match values to options, and report answer accuracy"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["选择可解的数值型 AQuA-RAT 题并保留五个选项"] --> B["定义 58 种运算并按领域分类以缩小运算空间"]
    B --> C["在动态平台上众包编写可执行运算程序"]
    C --> D["要求使用题中数值且最终值接近正确选项"]
    D --> E["控制标注员质量并以三人至少两票通过对齐验证"]
    E --> F["扩展到近重复模板并汇总 37,259 个样本"]
    F --> G["按 80/12/8 随机拆分训练、开发和测试集"]
    G --> H["解码执行程序、匹配选项并报告答案准确率"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with MathQA (NAACL 2019), Sections 3, 4, 6.1, 6.2, and 7.1. The paper enhances solvable AQuA-RAT multiple-choice problems with programs over 58 domain-aware operations; categorizes problems to prune operations; uses a dynamic crowd platform with execution feedback, submission constraints, worker quality tests, and at least two-of-three alignment validation; expands annotations to similar templates; reports the exact table total of 37,259 items and an 80/12/8 random split; and evaluates by executing predicted programs, matching their values to options, and measuring answer accuracy.
